.hero-action { width }: The canvas renders a button as a wrapper div containing a real <button>, and applies the element's styles to BOTH. The export has one element with one set of styles, so the wrapper measures the padding twice.
.what-you-get-list { height }: The canvas renders a list as a wrapper div containing the <ul>. The inner list keeps editor sizing the exported <ul> does not have.
.hero { height }: Accumulated: this container's height is the sum of the children above.
.what-you-get { height }: Accumulated: this container's height is the sum of the children above.
.page { height }: Accumulated: the root's height is the sum of every child above.
